description: Writes what the GUI state offers scripts (the sandbox, number formatting, the global table, api.*, the command factories) once as the game loads and once in a game, to %LOCALAPPDATA%/tpf3mp/probe or the game log. Changes nothing in the game.
name: TPF3-MP probe: script API dump
summary: Recon for TPF3-MP: dumps the script API of the GUI state. Read only.
